purpose: Route Windows bootstrap and repair through machine-specific local evidence without reusing another box's path assumptions.

structure.purpose: Canonical detector and local binding writer.
Maps, registries, workflows, schemas, reports, and completeness contracts.
Repair and certification runtime owner; outside harness mutation scope.

commands.build: not applicable; contract, script, test, and documentation harness
commands.deploy: not owned; bootstrap and live certification remain separate runtime gates

privacyBoundary: Real usernames, hostnames, tenant labels, role assignments, and resolved paths stay local. Tracked files use role IDs and environment-variable patterns only.
collisionBoundary: Owns role selection, path evidence, workflows, validation, reports, and handoff. Does not own product repair code, credentials, providers, or live target mutation.
proofCeiling: Harness structure and deterministic contracts only.
